parsed.name: USB2000光谱仪
parsed.description: Ocean Insight 的 USB2000 光谱仪，用于实验中采集样品的光谱数据，并通过设置积分时间来适配不同信号强度的光学测量。
parsed.description_en: An Ocean Insight USB2000 spectrometer used in laboratory experiments to acquire spectral data and adjust integration time for optical measurements with different signal levels.

actions.description_en: Retrieve the spectral data acquired by the spectrometer.

actions.description: 设置光谱采集的积分时间。
